summary: Retest of both fixes PASSED. FIX 1 (minutes propagation): verified in code - start-button onPress={() => onStart(minutes)} at index.tsx:189, startSession(minutes) uses `const seconds = minutes * 60` at :351, and PostHog session_started event carries planned_minutes = minutes at :359. FIX 2 (end-card gap): verified in code - styles.shareCanvas at :462 has NO 'space-between' (only paddingHorizontal:32/paddingVertical:34), and styles.cardStats at :463 = {flex:1, alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'} with wordmark rendered directly below cardStats. Regressions clean: SpeakScreen renders both copy lines ('Speak your chaos' :147, 'One thing at a time' :152), Group returns null when items.length===0 at :219. Backend regression: 8/8 pytest cases pass (test_execute_ai_api.py, 42s) covering /api/ai/transcribe (415/400/200), /api/ai/task (400/happy shape+word-limits), /api/ai/sort (empty buckets/union preservation). Speak screen verified in the web preview at 390x844: both grey copy lines flank the green mic circle.
critical_code_review_comments: Minutes state is still locally owned by ThingScreen but is now correctly passed to onStart(minutes), which resolves the previous divergence between UI-selected minutes and startSession's plannedSeconds.

shareCanvas layout is now driven by cardStats:flex:1 + justifyContent:center, so the wordmark sits directly beneath the centered stats block instead of being pushed to the bottom via space-between. Because cardStats absorbs the flex, the gap between the last stat label and the wordmark is a natural padding rather than a computed void - end-card gap is closed.

success_rate.frontend: Speak screen verified in browser preview (390x844). ThingScreen/SessionScreen/CardScreen verified via code inspection only - web preview cannot exercise expo-audio recording, per main-agent note.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes for iteration_4's HIGH-priority bugs are landed and verified. Backend regression harness lives at /app/backend/tests/test_execute_ai_api.py and reads EXPO_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. To exercise the minutes -> session -> card flow end-to-end without audio, expose a temporary dev hook (e.g., URL param that seeds phase='thing' with a synthetic Task) or run on a native build.
